How to build
Click to place a block, or hold and drag to paint a row. Clicking the side or top of a block stacks onto it.
Right-drag (or one-finger drag) to turn the camera. Scroll or pinch to zoom. WASD moves, Q and E turn.
Arrows on the right (or R and F) change the build height for floating blocks.
Erase removes blocks. Paint changes a block to the selected type and color. Ctrl+Z undoes.
Obby race needs a Finish block. Coin hunt needs coins. Press Test to play it with bots.
